blocks.text: Epidemiology (bimariyon ke phailao ka ilm) mein biostatistics se dekha jata hai ke population mein bimariyan kahan aur kitni hain (distribution) aur kin wajah se hoti hain (determinants). Is se public health ke mahireen samajhte hain ke bimari kaise phailti hai, risk factors (khatre ki wajahen) pehchante hain aur bachao ke iqdamaat ka asar jaanchte hain. Bimari ke rujhanaat (trends) ka model bana kar aur iqdamaat ke nataij parakh kar biostatistics wabaon (epidemics) ko rokne aur community ki sehat behtar karne mein madad deti hai.
